payload.text: Out past the lock. There is a gate that has been shut since November and I want to know if it is open.
the clocks
ive set one for saturday night. i lose an hour every single spring and i refuse to lose it standing in a kitchen at eleven wondering why the oven disagrees with me
Roster. April. Three, three, four, three, and the second week is Monday to Wednesday only.
the second week is my second week. thursday friday saturday sunday all yours and none of them are anybodys
Four days in a row in April. I have looked at it three times to check it is real.
we should do something with them. not a big thing. one day out of the four where we go somewhere that takes actual getting to
Somewhere with water. I have thought that for about a month and not said it.
a month. and you sat there. anyway yes. water
I am coming over tomorrow evening and I am bringing the parsnip and the last of the cake, which has gone slightly better with age, like a floor.
like a floor. thats going in the book
woke at nine and lay there for twenty minutes doing nothing with no list underneath it. i had forgotten that was available
That is the Saturday. Do not fill it.
four pages of the tree by the third bridge, all of them wrong, and on the fourth one i stopped trying to draw blossom and drew the gaps instead and that one is nearly it
Downstairs with a pot in a bag and a box on top of it. The door and I are going to have our conversation.
put the bag down first. you always try to do it one handed and it never once works
there it goes. the clocks. both of us stood in the kitchen looking at a phone like it had brought news
The oven clock is your problem. I have done the one on the cooker at mine and I will not be doing two.
an hour gone and nobody can tell me where. the oven still says half eight and it is going to say half eight until june, we both know it
I have offered nothing on the oven and I stand by that.
your boiler note went off an hour late in real terms and an hour early in oven terms. the gauge is fine. it has been fine for three weeks and i am suspicious of it
A quiet boiler is a boiler with a plan.
cake finished at half one standing up over the sink, both of us, no plates, in silence. that is how a cake should end

payload.title: the extra hour
payload.place: the towpath, out past the lock and back

payload.text: the gate is open. it has been open since february and neither of us has been out that far since the cold, so we have been walking to a shut gate in our heads for two months
Still light at seven. I kept checking as though it might be taken back.

payload.title: the extra hour
payload.note: cold once the sun went. worth going past the lock. the gate was open

payload.text: Four. Because of the cold.
because of the cold and because you talked about the exam for eleven minutes and thought i had not noticed you doing it
It is in eight weeks.

payload.title: sunday 9 call
payload.note: from two rooms of the same flat. twenty two minutes. we kept it

payload.text: You rang me from a room with a door open and I could hear you twice, once down the phone and once through the wall, half a second apart.
i heard you the same way and it was the funniest thing that has happened to me all month, and we still did the quiet minute
last week of term and it is light on the bus in a way it was not on friday. everybody on it looks like a different set of people
Two nights, then the roster starts again properly on Thursday. I have looked at April twice more.

payload.value: four days left and a trip form i am still ignoring

payload.text: the kiln man came at nine with the right part and it took him twenty minutes. twenty. after three weeks of the wrong one sitting in a van
firing thursday. the pots come out on thursday afternoon and i get to be in the room when he sees them
firing wednesday, out thursday afternoon. i get to be in the room when he sees them
Tell me what he says. Exactly what he says, not the tidy version.
i have put page three on the table again. it has moved from the table to the drawer to the table three times this month and it is still page three
I said nothing about it and I want that noticed.
it is noticed. it is the loudest nothing you have ever said
sat out on the step with a cup of tea at half nine in march. thats the first one of those since september and i have been waiting for it without knowing
Out. It was light before I finished, which has not happened since October and I stood in the doorway for a minute being stupid about it.
The plant on the sill has put out a new one. Small, pale, folded up like a fist.
you are going to end up carrying that plant home in a bag and telling me it followed you
last tuesday of march and no pot anywhere. the friday one does not count, we both agreed, and now the month has a hole at the end of it as well as the middle
April is a month with soup in it. Four Tuesdays and I am off for three of them.
march has been eleven days of nothing and one saturday i will think about for years and a hundred and eighteen small windows. i do not know how to add that up
You do not add it up. You keep the Saturday.
pots out of the kiln thursday. two days after that its easter and the whole thing goes quiet and we get four days in a row like people who live somewhere
